title: Qin unites the realm
summary: In ten years Qin conquers the six other states and its king becomes the First Emperor.
summary_zh: 十年之间，秦国先后灭掉韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐，秦王嬴政成为始皇帝。

steps.text: 246 BC: thirteen-year-old Ying Zheng becomes king of Qin at Xianyang. Behind the passes of the Wei valley, Qin is already the strongest of the seven states.
steps.text_zh: 前246年，十三岁的嬴政在咸阳即秦王位。秦据关中，背靠函谷关，已是七国中最强的一国。

steps.text: 230 BC: Han, the weakest state and Qin's direct neighbour to the east, falls first. Its king is captured and its land becomes Yingchuan commandery.
steps.text_zh: 前230年，最弱小、又紧挨秦国东面的韩国首先被灭，韩王安被俘，韩地设为颍川郡。

steps.text: 228 BC: Zhao, which had held out under the general Li Mu, falls after Li Mu is executed on false charges. Qin troops take Handan.
steps.text_zh: 前228年，赵国名将李牧被冤杀之后，秦将王翦攻破邯郸，赵王迁被俘。

steps.text: 225 BC: Wang Ben floods Daliang, the Wei capital, by diverting the Yellow River canals. After three months the walls give way.
steps.text_zh: 前225年，王贲引黄河、鸿沟之水灌大梁，三个月后城坏，魏王假投降。

steps.text: 223 BC: Chu, the largest state, is the hardest fight. A first army of 200,000 is beaten; Wang Jian then comes with 600,000 and takes Shouchun.
steps.text_zh: 前223年，疆域最大的楚国最难打。李信率二十万人先败，王翦再领六十万大军南下，攻破寿春，楚亡。

steps.text: 222 BC: Yan, whose crown prince had sent Jing Ke to kill the King of Qin, is pursued to Liaodong and destroyed.
steps.text_zh: 前222年，曾派荆轲刺秦的燕国被追击到辽东，燕王喜被俘，燕亡。

steps.text: 221 BC: Qi, which had stayed out of the wars, surrenders without a battle when Qin troops arrive from the north.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，长期置身事外的齐国在秦军自北南下时不战而降。

steps.text: 221 BC: the realm is one. Ying Zheng takes the new title Huangdi, splits the land into 36 commanderies and standardises script, coins and weights.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，天下一统。嬴政自称“始皇帝”，分天下为三十六郡，统一文字、货币和度量衡。

title: Zhang Qian opens the Western Regions
summary: An envoy sent to find allies against the Xiongnu comes back thirteen years later with knowledge of Central Asia.
summary_zh: 为联合大月氏夹击匈奴而出使的张骞，十三年后归来，带回了西域诸国的消息，开启了丝绸之路。

steps.text: About 139 BC: Emperor Wu sends Zhang Qian west with about a hundred men to find the Yuezhi, who had been driven out by the Xiongnu, and make them allies.
steps.text_zh: 约前139年，汉武帝派张骞率一百多人从长安出发，去寻找被匈奴赶走的大月氏，约其共击匈奴。

steps.text: Crossing the Hexi corridor, which the Xiongnu still control, the party is captured. Zhang Qian is held for about ten years, marries and has a son, but keeps his envoy's staff.
steps.text_zh: 途经匈奴控制的河西走廊时被俘，张骞被扣留约十年，娶妻生子，但始终持汉节不失。

steps.text: He escapes west across the Tian Shan to Dayuan (Ferghana), famous for its horses. The king of Dayuan sends him on with guides.
steps.text_zh: 他趁机逃脱，向西越过天山到达以汗血马闻名的大宛。大宛王派向导送他继续前行。

steps.text: Through Kangju he reaches the Yuezhi, now settled north of the Oxus and ruling Daxia (Bactria). They are prosperous and no longer want revenge.
steps.text_zh: 经康居到达大月氏。大月氏已在妫水（阿姆河）以北安居，并征服了大夏，生活富足，不想再与匈奴为敌。

steps.text: After a year he heads home along the southern edge of the Tarim basin, hoping to avoid the Xiongnu through the Qiang lands, but is captured again.
steps.text_zh: 一年后东归，想沿昆仑山北麓经羌人地区避开匈奴，结果再次被俘。

steps.text: 126 BC: in the turmoil after the Chanyu's death he escapes and reaches Chang'an with just one companion. His report describes Dayuan, Kangju, Daxia, Anxi (Parthia) and Shendu (India).
steps.text_zh: 前126年，趁匈奴单于去世内乱逃回长安，出发时一百多人，只剩两人。他向武帝详细介绍了大宛、康居、大夏、安息、身毒等国。

steps.text: After Han wins the Hexi corridor, he goes west again to the Wusun. His deputies visit many states; from now on envoys and trade caravans travel the road we call the Silk Road.
steps.text_zh: 汉朝夺得河西之后，张骞再次出使乌孙，副使分赴各国。此后使者和商队往来不绝，这条路后来被称为丝绸之路。

title: The Battle of Red Cliffs
summary: Cao Cao's push south is stopped on the Yangtze, and the realm splits three ways.
summary_zh: 曹操南下统一的步伐在长江边被孙刘联军挡住，从此天下三分。

steps.text: 207: Liu Bei, a guest of Liu Biao in Jing province, visits Zhuge Liang three times. Zhuge Liang lays out the plan: take Jing and Yi provinces and ally with Sun Quan.
steps.text_zh: 207年，寄居荆州的刘备三顾茅庐，诸葛亮提出隆中对：占据荆、益二州，东联孙权，北抗曹操。

steps.text: Autumn 208: having unified the north, Cao Cao marches south. Liu Biao dies and his son Liu Cong surrenders Jing province without a fight.
steps.text_zh: 208年秋，统一北方的曹操挥师南下。刘表病死，其子刘琮不战而降，荆州落入曹操之手。

steps.text: Cao Cao's cavalry catches Liu Bei's fleeing column at Changban. Liu Bei escapes east to Xiakou with a few thousand men.
steps.text_zh: 曹军轻骑在当阳长坂坡追上南逃的刘备，刘备只带少数人突围，东走夏口。

steps.text: Zhuge Liang goes to Sun Quan at Chaisang. Against advisers who urge surrender, Sun Quan and Zhou Yu decide to fight.
steps.text_zh: 诸葛亮出使柴桑面见孙权。在众人主张投降之际，孙权与周瑜、鲁肃决意抗曹，孙刘联盟形成。

steps.text: Winter 208: at Red Cliffs, Huang Gai feigns surrender and sails fire ships into Cao Cao's chained fleet. Sickness and the fire break the northern army.
steps.text_zh: 208年冬，两军相持于赤壁。黄盖诈降，以火船冲入曹军连在一起的战船，加上北军水土不服、疾疫流行，曹军大败。

steps.text: Cao Cao retreats north through the marshes of Huarong back to Jiangling and then the north, leaving Cao Ren to hold the line.
steps.text_zh: 曹操经华容道狼狈北撤，留曹仁守江陵，自己返回北方。

steps.text: Liu Bei takes the commanderies south of the Yangtze; Sun Quan keeps the lower river. Cao Cao never crosses the Yangtze again, and three states take shape.
steps.text_zh: 战后刘备取得荆州江南四郡，孙权稳守江东。曹操再未能渡江，三国鼎立的格局由此奠定。

title: Xuanzang's journey to India
summary: A monk leaves Chang'an without permission, studies in India and returns sixteen years later with 657 texts.
summary_zh: 玄奘私自出关西行求法，在印度游学十多年，带回佛经六百五十七部。

steps.text: 629 (some say 627): Xuanzang, troubled by contradictions between Buddhist texts, sets out for India. The border is closed, so he leaves without permission.
steps.text_zh: 629年（一说627年），玄奘因佛经译本互相矛盾，决心西行求取原典。当时边关禁止出境，他只能私自出发。

steps.text: He slips past the Yumen beacon towers at night and crosses the Mokhayan desert alone, nearly dying of thirst.
steps.text_zh: 他夜过玉门关外的烽燧，独自穿越八百里莫贺延碛，几乎渴死在沙漠中。

steps.text: At Gaochang (Turfan) King Qu Wentai welcomes him and tries to keep him. Xuanzang goes on hunger strike until the king lets him go, with letters and supplies.
steps.text_zh: 到达高昌，国王麴文泰盛情挽留，玄奘绝食明志。国王终于放行，并赠送路费、人马和给沿途各国的书信。

steps.text: Over the Tian Shan he meets the Khagan of the Western Turks near Suyab, whose protection opens the road through Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 翻越天山，在素叶城一带见到西突厥可汗，得到可汗的保护和文书，得以穿越中亚诸国。

steps.text: Via Samarkand and the Hindu Kush he reaches India and studies for about five years at Nalanda under the abbot Silabhadra.
steps.text_zh: 经撒马尔罕，越兴都库什山进入印度，在那烂陀寺师从戒贤法师学习约五年。

steps.text: 642: King Harsha holds a great assembly at Kanyakubja; Xuanzang defends his teaching for eighteen days and no one refutes him.
steps.text_zh: 642年，戒日王在曲女城召开大会，玄奘为论主，十八天无人能驳倒他，声名远播。

steps.text: Turning down offers to stay, he crosses the Pamirs and waits at Khotan for the emperor's pardon for leaving illegally.
steps.text_zh: 他谢绝挽留，翻越葱岭东归，在于阗上表请罪，等待唐太宗的回复。

steps.text: 645: Chang'an turns out to greet him. He spends the rest of his life translating, and dictates the Record of the Western Regions.
steps.text_zh: 645年回到长安，万人空巷。此后他专心译经，并口述《大唐西域记》。

title: The An Lushan rebellion
summary: Eight years of war that broke the Tang at its height.
summary_zh: 八年战乱，盛唐由此转衰。

steps.text: Winter 755: An Lushan, commander of three frontier armies, rises at Fanyang (Beijing) with some 150,000 men, claiming to remove the chancellor Yang Guozhong.
steps.text_zh: 755年冬，身兼三镇节度使的安禄山以讨杨国忠为名，在范阳（今北京）起兵，号称二十万。

steps.text: The rebels cross the Yellow River and take Luoyang in just over a month. Early in 756 An Lushan proclaims himself emperor of Great Yan there.
steps.text_zh: 叛军渡过黄河，一个多月便攻陷东都洛阳。756年初，安禄山在洛阳称帝，国号大燕。

steps.text: Summer 756: forced by the court to leave his strong position, Geshu Han is routed outside Tong Pass. The road to Chang'an lies open.
steps.text_zh: 756年夏，哥舒翰被朝廷逼令出关迎战，大败于灵宝，潼关失守，长安门户洞开。

steps.text: Emperor Xuanzong flees west. At Mawei the guards kill Yang Guozhong and force the emperor to have Consort Yang strangled.
steps.text_zh: 唐玄宗仓皇西逃。行至马嵬驿，禁军哗变，杀死杨国忠，并逼玄宗赐死杨贵妃。

steps.text: The crown prince goes north to Lingwu and takes the throne as Suzong; Xuanzong, now in Sichuan, accepts it. Guo Ziyi's frontier army becomes the core of the fight back.
steps.text_zh: 太子李亨北上灵武即位，是为唐肃宗，避入蜀中的玄宗被尊为太上皇。郭子仪的朔方军成为平叛主力。

steps.text: 757: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan hold Suiyang for ten months, keeping the rebels out of the Huai valley and the grain of the south.
steps.text_zh: 757年，张巡、许远死守睢阳十个月，城破殉国，但挡住了叛军南下江淮，保住了唐朝的财赋之地。

steps.text: Autumn 757: with Uyghur cavalry, Tang armies retake Chang'an and Luoyang. An Lushan has already been murdered by his own son.
steps.text_zh: 757年秋，唐军借回纥骑兵收复长安、洛阳。此前安禄山已被儿子安庆绪所杀。

steps.text: Shi Siming takes over the rebellion, beats the Tang at Yecheng in 759 and retakes Luoyang, but in 761 he too is killed by his son.
steps.text_zh: 史思明接掌叛军，759年在邺城大败唐军，再陷洛阳；761年也被儿子史朝义所杀。

steps.text: 763: Shi Chaoyi kills himself and the war ends. But rebel generals keep Hebei as near-independent governors, Tibet takes the northwest, and the Tang never regains its old strength.
steps.text_zh: 763年，史朝义兵败自杀，战乱结束。但降将据有河北成为藩镇，吐蕃乘虚夺取河西陇右，唐朝从此再未恢复盛世。

title: Zheng He's voyages
summary: Seven voyages of the largest fleet of its time, from the Yangtze to Arabia and East Africa.
summary_zh: 七下西洋，当时世界上最庞大的船队从长江口一直航行到阿拉伯半岛和东非。

steps.text: 1405: the eunuch admiral Zheng He sails from Liujiagang near the Yangtze mouth with over 200 ships and about 27,000 men, sent by the Yongle Emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1405年，宦官郑和奉永乐帝之命，率二百多艘船、两万七千余人，从长江口的刘家港出发。

steps.text: The fleet waits at Fujian for the northeast monsoon, then calls at Champa on the coast of today's Vietnam.
steps.text_zh: 船队在福建等候东北季风，然后南下，第一站是今越南中部的占城。

steps.text: Malacca becomes the fleet's main base: warehouses are built there, and ships gather to wait for the monsoon to turn.
steps.text_zh: 满剌加（马六甲）成为船队的中转基地，在此设立仓库，各分队在这里会合，等待季风转向。

steps.text: In Ceylon Zheng He leaves a stone tablet in Chinese, Tamil and Persian; on the third voyage he fights and captures a hostile local king.
steps.text_zh: 在锡兰（斯里兰卡）立下汉文、泰米尔文、波斯文三语石碑；第三次航行时与当地国王交战并将其俘获。

steps.text: Calicut on the Malabar coast, the great pepper port, is the goal of the first three voyages.
steps.text_zh: 印度西南岸的古里（卡利卡特）是胡椒贸易大港，前三次航行都以此为终点。

steps.text: From the fourth voyage on the fleet goes further, to Hormuz at the mouth of the Persian Gulf; detachments reach Aden, Mecca and the coast of East Africa, bringing back a giraffe.
steps.text_zh: 第四次起航程更远，到达波斯湾口的忽鲁谟斯；分队远至阿丹（亚丁）、天方（麦加）和东非沿岸，还带回了长颈鹿。

steps.text: 1433: on the way home from the seventh voyage Zheng He dies, probably near Calicut. The court ends the voyages and the records are later lost or destroyed.
steps.text_zh: 1433年，第七次下西洋返航途中，郑和在古里一带去世。此后明朝停止远航，相关档案也散失。
